title: Deep Star Maps 2020
credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio. Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC. Visualization: Ernie Wright (USRA).
processing: Celestial 4096 x 2048 EXR converted with macOS sips to display RGB PNG, then WebP quality 94. Shader adjusts exposure and framing; positions are catalogue-derived. Not a current Earth sky or a single photographic exposure.
